title: DataRedact01's Textures
description: A Resource Pack having textures I've made for my projects.
body:
This texture pack is the required texture pack for my Hide & Seek Map that I'm working on.
As of right now it includes images for:

(Name) [Ability] (File Name to use Texture)

- Far Scan [Ability] (minecraft:item/hideandseek/far_scan)
- Echolocation [Ability] (minecraft:item/hideandseek/echolocation)
- Locked on [Ability] (minecraft:item/hideandseek/locked_on)
- Enhanced Vision [Ability] (minecraft:item/hideandseek/enhanced_vision)
- Smoke Bomb [Ability] (minecraft:item/hideandseek/smoke_bomb)
- Natural Mimic [Ability] (minecraft:item/hideandseek/natural_mimic)
- Bloodlust [Ability] (minecraft:item/hideandseek/bloodlust)
